spark: Gruk ran from the high pass when raiders came for his clan's herd, and his young cousin held it alone and died

focal.name: Gruk Ironjaw
focal.who: A big wolfman who flinches at horn calls.
focal.backstory: Gruk Ironjaw was set to hold the high pass with his young cousin when raiders came for the clan's herd. He ran; his cousin stayed, and the clan buried him with the herd lost.

note: personal set pers1 (round T, North Star item 0): one of 8 company soldiers with a varied one-line past (the spark = the backstory's first sentence, as the game's personalSeed reads it)
